meta.premiseEvidence: Studio Oracle and direct source inspection confirm four live gaps: App calls resolveOperationWave only from the common enemy-wave-clear branch; useOperationMode advances every verb with completed:true; overlay interactions are optional and award one identical +25/+5 result; priorRouteConsequence has no consumer while routeConsequence is a string whose callers read .id; and paired playtest creation does not select a real local Standard run. The S156 baseline remains 209/209 files and 1,205/1,205 tests.

recommendation.firstBuild: Make the seven shipped Operation verbs mechanically authoritative before adding content breadth.
recommendation.productDestination: Objective-gated Operations with durable local consequences and provenance-bound participant evidence.
recommendation.keep: Preserve guest-first play, all eight Arcade identifiers, local deterministic trust, async rivalry boundaries, and FORGE/SPARKED separation.
recommendation.rejectNow: A fourth Operation, broad campaign expansion, realtime co-op, competitive multiplayer, battle royale, hosted mission generation, or automatic balance tuning.
recommendation.reason: The highest-value work converts already-shipped presentation into executable grammar and improves the evidence used for future expansion decisions without new infrastructure or variable cost.

gameLoopReview.evidenceBoundary: No participant playtest corpus exists. Scores measure executable design structure, not fun, balance, retention, or satisfaction.

axisCoverage.feature depth & refinement: Promote each Operation verb from a label/bonus into an objective authority that can block advancement and emit a distinct consequence.
axisCoverage.innovation: Use reinforcement pressure and replay-bound encounter proofs to make an arcade wave spine behave like authored mission grammar without a separate engine.
axisCoverage.ui / ux / user-experience: Show required objective state, blocked reason, reinforcement count, route effect, and carry-in consequence in the existing compact overlay/deck.
axisCoverage.feedback loop: Require a real local Standard-run evidence reference before a paired receipt counts toward campaign or co-op gates.
axisCoverage.gamification / engagement / immersion: Persist completion routes and authored carry-ins so choices echo across Operations without an account wall or grind treadmill.
axisCoverage.ai / intelligence integration: Repair Mission Director route-consequence inputs and keep all guidance deterministic, reason-coded, local, and player-opt-in.
axisCoverage.security: Treat local evidence as untrusted, bounded, schema-versioned data; export aggregates only and never let Operation receipts mint standard leaderboard authority.
axisCoverage.speed / organization / efficiency: Centralize encounter action definitions and campaign-state reducers instead of adding more App.jsx conditionals or duplicated UI maps.
axisCoverage.token / api cost reduction: No hosted inference, realtime service, new dependency, or per-player API call; all logic remains compact deterministic data.

items.why: All seven encounter verbs currently advance from the same enemy-wave-clear path, and every arena action is optional with the same score/health reward. That leaves the Operation grammar presentational rather than authoritative.
items.recipe: Create one pure encounter-objective contract owning verb actions, completion evidence, effects, blocked reasons, and reinforcement receipts. Require the correct interaction plus arena clear before advancement; if absent, keep the encounter active for a reinforcement wave. Wire the overlay, Mission Director, operation receipt, and focused browser/runtime tests to the same source.
items.measurement: Each verb has one source-derived objective/action contract; a cleared wave without the action cannot advance; a valid action plus clear advances exactly once; keyboard/controller/touch paths remain available; receipts identify action, effect, reinforcement count, and reason; all legacy modes remain unchanged.

L1.recipe: Centralize the seven action definitions and require interaction before wave-clear advancement.

L2.recipe: Add objective reducer, reinforcement pressure, distinct bounded action effects, overlay progress/reasons, receipt evidence, App integration, and tests.

L3.recipe: Add spatial proximity and moving-objective simulation only after participant evidence shows the L2 grammar is understood and replayed.

items.why: Operation definitions declare a priorRouteConsequence, but completion history has no campaign reducer or consumer. Current routeConsequence is also a string while Mission Director callers read an object id, so the explanation path is silent.
items.recipe: Represent route consequences as typed objects, persist a bounded local campaign ledger, record completion/route/fingerprint, derive authored carry-ins for later Operations, apply those carry-ins through deterministic arena transitions, and show completion/carry-in state on the command deck without locking guest content.
items.measurement: Completing an Operation records one idempotent bounded entry; replay/rematch does not duplicate progress; later Operation start deterministically applies only a matching declared carry-in; Mission Director and receipts name the route/carry-in reason; all Operations remain guest-playable.

L1.recipe: Fix typed route consequences and persist completion/route receipts locally.

L2.recipe: Add bounded campaign reducer/storage, authored cross-Operation carry-ins, command-deck status, Mission Director/receipt wiring, and tests.

L3.recipe: Add branching finales only after ten provenance-valid paired receipts justify campaign expansion.

items.why: The paired feedback form is consentful and aggregate-only, but it accepts a manually entered Standard duration and ratings without selecting an actual local Standard run. Such rows are explicit opinions but weak comparative evidence for the 10/20 expansion gates.
items.recipe: Select a bounded recent non-practice Standard run from local history, derive an identifier-free evidence reference, require both that reference and the completed Operation fingerprint in schema v2, exclude legacy/unbound rows from decision gates, and explain the missing-baseline state in plain player language.
items.measurement: No paired receipt is created without one valid local Standard evidence reference and the current Operation fingerprint; exports contain aggregates and provenance counts but no raw runs, identifiers, free text, or exact timestamps; old rows remain readable but do not count toward gates.

L1.recipe: Require evidence-reference fields in a versioned receipt and reject unbound rows from gates.

L2.recipe: Add recent-Standard selector, identifier-free reference derivation, schema-v2 aggregation/provenance, honest empty state, and tests.

L3.recipe: Import consented aggregate cohorts into Balance Lab only after a real sample exists and governance is defined.

Typed route effects, bounded idempotent local completion ledger, authored cross-Operation carry-ins, deterministic arena transitions, visible command-deck state, and focused tests.
